title: Python, from zero to building things
destination: You can open a blank file and build a working program — a game, a GUI app, a data tool — without needing a tutorial open next to you.

stages.title: First contact
stages.outcome: You can run code, store values, and understand what the machine is doing.

skills.title: Running Python
skills.outcome: Run a program and see its output
checks: Write and run a one-line program
Tell the difference between an editor and a terminal
Recognise when a program produced no output at all

skills.title: Variables
skills.outcome: Name a value and use it later
checks: Predict what a variable holds after several assignments
Explain why a bad name causes an error

skills.title: Numbers and strings
skills.outcome: Know the difference between 7 and "7"
checks: Build strings with quotes and escapes

skills.title: print and input
skills.outcome: Talk to the user and read their answer
checks: Debug an input that arrives as text

skills.title: Operators
skills.outcome: Do arithmetic and compare values
checks: Compare with == and != without mixing up =

skills.title: Reading errors
skills.outcome: Turn a red traceback into a fix
checks: Find the line an error points to
Fix the most common beginner mistakes

stages.title: Making decisions and repeating
stages.outcome: You can make a program react to its input and loop until it's done.

skills.title: True and False
skills.outcome: Reason about conditions

skills.title: if / elif / else
skills.outcome: Branch your program's behaviour
checks: Order branches so the right one wins

skills.title: while loops
skills.outcome: Repeat until a condition changes

skills.title: for loops and range
skills.outcome: Repeat over a known number of things

skills.title: break and continue
skills.outcome: Control the loop from inside
checks: Exit early when a condition is met

skills.title: Loop patterns
skills.outcome: Build shapes, tables and sequences
checks: Nested loops that print a triangle

stages.title: Collections
stages.outcome: You can hold many values and get the right one back out.

skills.title: Lists
skills.outcome: Store an ordered group of things
checks: Know when a list is the right container

skills.title: Growing and shrinking lists
skills.outcome: Add, remove and sort
checks: Explain why remove() fails on a missing value

skills.title: Dictionaries
skills.outcome: Look things up by name instead of position

skills.title: Tuples and sets
skills.outcome: Pick the right shape for the data
checks: Use a tuple for a fixed record

skills.title: Slicing
skills.outcome: Take a chunk out of a sequence

skills.title: Comprehensions
skills.outcome: Build a collection in one line without losing readability
checks: Know when a loop is clearer

skills.title: Nested data
skills.outcome: Navigate a list of dicts

stages.title: Functions and structure
stages.outcome: You can break a problem into pieces and reuse them.

skills.title: Defining functions
skills.outcome: Wrap behaviour behind a name
checks: Explain why a function with no call does nothing

skills.title: Parameters
skills.outcome: Design a friendly function signature

skills.title: Returning values
skills.outcome: Send a result back instead of printing it

skills.title: Scope and mutation
skills.outcome: Understand what a function can see and change
checks: Predict what happens when a list is passed in

skills.title: import and the standard library
skills.outcome: Use code you didn't write
checks: Find a module in the docs

skills.title: Handling errors
skills.outcome: Keep a program alive when something goes wrong

skills.title: Debugging
skills.outcome: Find the bug instead of guessing
checks: Bisect a problem by testing pieces

stages.title: Objects and files
stages.outcome: You can model a thing, keep it on disk, and organise a project.

skills.title: Classes
skills.outcome: Model a thing that has state and behaviour
checks: Define a class and create instances
Choose a class over a dict

skills.title: Methods and __init__
skills.outcome: Give an object a setup step and actions
checks: Call a method on an instance

skills.title: Dunder methods
skills.outcome: Make your objects behave like built-ins

skills.title: Inheritance and composition
skills.outcome: Reuse behaviour without copy-paste

skills.title: Files
skills.outcome: Read and write data on disk

skills.title: JSON and persistence
skills.outcome: Save state between runs
checks: Convert an object to a dict
Recover from a corrupted save file

skills.title: Projects and packages
skills.outcome: Split code across files that import each other

stages.title: Building real things
stages.outcome: You can ship a program that other people can actually use.

skills.title: Turtle graphics
skills.outcome: Draw with code and see it happen
checks: Draw a shape with a loop

skills.title: Flet apps
skills.outcome: Put a real interface on your code
checks: Build a page with a button
Lay out controls in a column or row

skills.title: Pygame
skills.outcome: Make an animated, interactive game loop

skills.title: APIs and requests
skills.outcome: Get data from the internet

skills.title: Testing
skills.outcome: Prove your code works, and keep it working

skills.title: Project structure
skills.outcome: Make a project someone else could pick up

skills.title: Capstone
skills.outcome: Build something from a blank file, alone
